biography: I am a detail-oriented and quality-focused Industrial Real Estate Developer with advanced knowledge in identifying potential industry development sites, conducting feasibility studies, and managing development projects. I am experienced in developing financial models to ensure potential profitability and present for project financing. Throughout the project life cycle, I monitor budgets and financial performance to make the necessary adjustments. I oversee the development of architectural and engineering drawings and verify that designs comply with local regulations, building codes, and industry standards. An engaging communicator, I collaborate with architects, engineers, consultants and contractors to complete the entitlement process as well as create detailed project plans and designs. I possess the insight to work with legal counsel, address legal issues related to the development process, and maintain compliance with zoning laws. I take charge over bid negotiation, scheduling, goal-setting, and any changes in project scope. Additionally, I am dedicated to quality control, risk management, and developing stakeholder relations.
